LIBRARYOFRUINA-INCOMPATIBLE_MOD_NOTICE.b:
Mods incompatible with Library of Ruina were detected:

{mods}

To protect your save, Library of Ruina skipped all content injection for this session: monsters, encounters, page relics and related settings are not active.

Unsubscribe from or disable the mods above, then restart the game.
LIBRARYOFRUINA-INCOMPATIBLE_MOD_REASON.H: This mod patches the type check of the vanilla Neurosurge power and throws inside the page reward and choose-a-card screens, freezing the reward screen.
